listing.name: Ultraman Fighting Evolution 3 — ufe3-recomp (idiazraz)
listing.summary: Experimental project. Not playable; boot reaches memory-card service boundary; setup and recompile scripts require local source. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Japanese SLPS-25441 disc and ELF. This guide does not include the exact supported revision or hash; check the project’s original-file requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Run setup.sh to obtain and build the pinned PS2Recomp version. Use rebuild.sh with your own Japanese disc to regenerate the game ELF and build the native Linux runner.

warnings: Not playable; boot reaches memory-card service boundary; setup and recompile scripts require local source.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
